findings.summary: Not executable through the stabilized Domain tool boundary.
findings.evidence: Requires unavailable mcp_codegenie tools and has no devecocli adapter.

findings.summary: Repair loop is pseudocode rather than reproducible execution.
findings.evidence: No implementation scripts or command/evidence capture exist.

findings.summary: Automatic mutation and dependency guidance bypasses authorization.
findings.evidence: Promises fixes and ohpm install without task-scoped permission.
Static, build, signing, package and runtime outcomes are not separated.
Diagnostic mappings and API substitutions lack exact sources and baselines.

findings.summary: Artifact locations and example results are asserted without project evidence.
findings.evidence: Hard-coded paths and synthetic output are presented as defaults.

findings.summary: Skill inputs and outputs are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Project/toolchain/scope/permission inputs and structured evidence outputs are missing.
Universal P1/P2 mappings lack project policy and safety controls.
Examples invent values, types and control flow without verification.
CodeGenie and deveco-mcp dependencies differ and are unpinned.

findings.summary: Provenance and language policy are unmet.
findings.evidence: Derived Chinese guidance and synthetic references lack claim-level sources.

blocked_reasons: Blocked until executable devecocli delegation and inputs exist.
Automated repair blocked until explicit permissions and semantic verification exist.
Version-sensitive claims blocked until sourced against applicable baselines.
Verification blocked until outcome classes are separated and retained.
